author: TeIq
content:
Decomposition complete. Created 5 epic issues (#2-#6, M0-M4) and 29 child issues (#7-#35), each with a --kind plan comment carrying:
- Scope mapping to REQs/ACs from .design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md and sections from design.md
- Concrete deliverables (file paths, modules, crates)
- References (design refs + proto-blue crate paths + Rust API Guidelines pointers)
- Issue-specific Rust-quality checklist (thiserror, Send+Sync, no unwrap in hot paths, newtype IDs, parameterized SQL, etc.)
- Testing approach
- Objective done-when criteria

Block chain at epic level: M0 (#2) ← M1 (#3) ← M2 (#4) ← M3 (#5) ← M4 (#6).

Children counts: M0=5, M1=4, M2=6, M3=4, M4=10.

Implementation entry point: start with #7 (workspace setup) — it's the root of the dependency graph and the foundation everything else assumes.
